`qwen-tokenizer.json` contains a reduced set of vocabulary entries and merge rules from [Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B). The examples' expected encodings were generated independently with Hugging Face's `tokenizers` library against the complete official tokenizer. Token IDs are remapped into the reduced vocabulary; original merge order is preserved. These derived tokenizer entries are covered by the accompanying [Apache 2.0 license](LICENSE-QWEN.txt).

`qwen38-shapes.json` records metadata and tensor shapes from the Ollama `qwen3.8:27b` Q4_K_M GGUF identified by its SHA-256 in the fixture. It contains no model weights. Tests verify that the optional prediction layer is excluded from ordinary decoding and that required hybrid-attention tensors are validated.
